23x Faster Inserts with UUID v7 in Postgres 18
item.description: 📌 Overview We recently switched to version 7 (v7) uuid primary keys and saw significantly faster inserts for some tables. The databases were running Postgres 18.4 and mostly used v1 with some v4 uuid values for primary keys. (1 source: postgresweekly)

item.title: the 30th birthday we noted in July
item.description: On July 8, 1996, the PostgreSQL community picked up the flame from Postgres95. Thirty years later, it has grown from a Berkeley research project into a default foundation of the global database ecosystem. (1 source: postgresweekly)
